mission.goal: Update the StarCi runtime so it selects one of two execution topologies from user demand: a single-mission topology and a coordinated multi-workstream topology, using durable names clearer than the temporary isolated/controller labels.
mission.target: The installed .claude skills tree and its executable orchestration contracts
includes: Define the two user-level execution topologies and their selection rule in one authoritative home
Define the coordinating agent's tracking and routing responsibilities for multi-workstream demand
Update schemas, validators, generated artifacts, English authority documents, Vietnamese mirrors, tests, and release evidence as required
excludes: Implement or modify the Nivo product features discussed in the referenced tasks
Change frontend or backend product behavior outside the .claude runtime
outputs: Automated validation covering topology selection and coordination
Evidence note and green skills-tree test run

doneWhen.evidence: The runtime exposes exactly two clearly named user-demand execution topologies with one enforced selection contract, and coordinated mode owns tracking of multiple workstreams.
The updated contracts, validators, mirrors, generated artifacts, and regression tests pass the complete skills-tree validation suite.

mission.verification: Validate the authoritative resource/schema and its consumer gates, exercise one single-demand fixture and one coordinated multi-workstream fixture grounded in the referenced Nivo tasks, then run the complete .claude test suite.
mission.example: A self-contained request runs as one mission; a request spanning the referenced accounting, chatbot, and analysis workstreams runs under one coordinating agent that tracks their typed outcomes.
